species.name: Crappie
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.
West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.

Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.
West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
